title: Valid Sudoku
prompt:
Given a 9×9 Sudoku board (`char[][]`, empty cells are `'.'`), decide whether it is valid: no digit repeats within any row, any column, or any of the nine 3×3 sub-boxes. You do NOT need to check solvability — only the filled cells.

Encode each seen digit with a key like `"row3-7"`, `"col5-7"`, `"box1,2-7"` in one HashSet; a collision means invalid.
hints: One HashSet<String> for the whole board. For a filled cell (r, c) with digit d, try to add three keys.
Box index: `r / 3` and `c / 3` map each cell to its 3×3 box.
`set.add(key)` returns false if the key already exists — a repeat means return false.

solution.explanation: One O(81) pass. Each digit stakes three claims (its row, column, and box); the first duplicate claim fails to add and returns false. Integer-divide by 3 to bucket cells into boxes.
